items.claim: In its September Economic Outlook, Nordea Group Chief Economist Helge Pedersen said 'the global economy is demonstrating remarkable resilience in the face of geopolitical conflict, elevated energy prices and trade tensions', and the bank said the Nordic economies continue to outperform other regions while downside risks remain.
items.source: Nordea press release 'Nordea Economic Outlook: Resilience in motion'; quote attributed to Helge Pedersen

items.claim: Nordea Bank Abp announced its 2027 financial reporting calendar, saying the Annual Report for 2026 'will be published in week 8, 2027, at the latest' and that the Annual General Meeting will be held on 24 March 2027.

Kirsi Wiitala, chef for Transaction Banking i Nordea, sagde om bankens tilslutning til Swifts betalingsordning som Gateway Intermediary, at kunderne i stigende grad efterspoerger en soemloes graenseoverskridende betalingsoplevelse, og at Nordea som 'the gateway to the Nordics' styrker sit kommercielle tilbud og bruger sin nordiske skala.
items.source: Kirsi Wiitala, Head of Transaction Banking, Nordea

items.claim: Petteri Aenkilae, chef for Large Corporate and Institutions i Nordea, sagde at Norden konsekvent frembringer globalt konkurrencedygtige virksomheder, og at udfordringen er at sikre at flere af dem forbliver nordiske naar de skalerer, og at Europa har brug for stoerre puljer af vaekstkapital, dybere kapitalmarkeder og mere graenseoverskridende investering.
items.source: Petteri Aenkilae, Head of Large Corporate and Institutions, Nordea

items.claim: Jyrki Katainen, formand for Nordic Compass' bestyrelse og chef for Group Public and Regulatory Affairs i Nordea, sagde at de nordiske lande tilsammen udgoer en af verdens mest innovative og velstaaende oekonomiske regioner, men at de nordiske kapitalmarkeder fortsat i hoej grad er nationale.
items.source: Jyrki Katainen, Chair of the Nordic Compass Board og Head of Group Public and Regulatory Affairs, Nordea

items.claim: Kirsten Renner, Group CIO i Nordea, udtalte: «AI has the potential to make financial services safer, faster and more personal. But the same technology is also making fraud easier to scale and harder to detect.»

Kirsten Renner udtalte videre: «In financial services, accountability can never be delegated to an algorithm. AI helps identify risks, but it is humans who make judgements and take decisions» og «The future of financial services will not be defined by who deploys the most AI. It will be defined by who earns the most trust while doing so.»

Malthe Falck, Head of Group Digital i Nordea, udtalte om nordisk fintech: «Strong digital infrastructure, high levels of customer adoption and a focus on solving real customer problems have created fertile ground for innovation.»
items.source: Malthe Falck, Head of Group Digital, Nordea
